failure_modes: A temporal_teacher_blend edit (C009-C011) would reweight regional attention using observed-node teachers whose contrast sign reverses within the window, displacing surrounding coordinates without demonstrated affinity benefit.
Selecting a pointcloud_delta_A or teacher_neighbors edit would change only dose or static teacher count, which the supplied evidence does not link to improved final predicted affinity.
Treating the continuous contrast curves as physical interaction energies or as affinity-head derivatives would misstate the reward semantics and is not supported by the information audit.
rationale: D1.2: The registered time-conditioned alternatives split into two kinds. C008 (temporal_region_index) and C009-C011 (temporal_teacher_blend) change teacher coordinates/regional attention at observed score nodes; C001-C003 (pointcloud_delta_A) and C004-C007 (region_index, teacher_neighbors) change only dose or static teacher count. The supplied continuous contrast curves show sign changes and rate reversals with no accepted polynomial (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c), and the curve-support selection retained only 24 features under a fidelity rule within the observed window [0.0,0.5] (E0857891f4effbfe1, Ed4e7d28e7b0423e0). That supports the direction of H001 but not a specific blend value: no held-out observed-node comparison of a time-conditioned rule against the constant rule is supplied, so the expected advantage of any particular temporal blend is unquantified. D4.1: The incumbent already uses teacher_neighbors=4, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, region_index=0 and no temporal blend, with the endpoint-VJP reward view and affinity-primary objective (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1). The offered edits are either already at the incumbent value (C002, C006, C004) or move away from it without evidence of expected advantage; the temporal blends (C009-C011) are the only genuinely new mechanism, but the evidence is observational and the information audit explicitly states the geometric nearest-teacher comparison is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that teacher score correlations are not a validated affinity predictor (E2bb8390452ed517a). D4.2: The predicted failure of a temporal blend is that it reweights regional attention toward observed-node teachers whose sign reverses across the window, displacing surrounding coordinates that the static detached background currently holds stable, while the affinity-first objective is unchanged and no terminal affinity label is available to confirm benefit; lineage support also shows sparse ancestral coverage and survival credit that is not terminal affinity (Ed0d7945bdeeda8f1). Because the evidence does not establish a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent and the affinity-first priority is not served by an unvalidated attention reweighting, retaining the incumbent is the correct bounded choice.
